On February 11, 2026 evening, the Kosovo Parliament re-elected Albin Kurti as Prime Minister following his party's victory in the early general election, thus ending a year-long institutional deadlock. Parliamentary elections were held on 28 December, after Albin Kurti failed in his attempt to build a majority following the first round of voting in February 2025.
